scope: Existing CNN alpha=1 saved Train/Validation prediction_1 only; no inference/remote/training/Test; no existing result replacement
history: Exact frozen loader context: 84-month lookback, max_seq_len84, target excluded, seq sorted per entity; verify saved history and identity
d2: log1p(previous observed quantity)-log1p(second previous observed quantity)

patterns.insufficient_history: history_length <3; d1 retained when >=2 but no d2/magnitude
patterns.stagnation: history>=3 and at least one of d1,d2 exactly zero

magnitude.cut_source: all unique eligible Train targets, not repeated over seeds
magnitude.ties: retain fixed inequalities, allow empty bins, no threshold optimization

baselines.history_mean: arithmetic mean raw quantity over exact observed context

regret: CNN AE/SE minus naive AE/SE on identical target; positive means CNN worse
row_weight: 1 per target; each seed analyzed separately
common_entity_weight: For each reported cell c, S_c=entities having >=1 Train AND >=1 Validation row in c. Within split s/c, each row entity e has w=1/n_(e,s,c). Thus each retained entity has mass1; normalized metric=(1/|S_c|) sum_e (1/n_e) sum_i metric_i. Pattern summaries use S_pattern; finer magnitude cells use S_(pattern,bin), separately disclosed. No exact-history matching.
checks: cross-seed target identities and raw quantities
selection first strict finite minimum epochs9/5/8
hand calculated regret and entity weights
pattern/conditional magnitude count and SSE/AE/signed error additive closure for rowweighted summaries; weighted cells have different estimands, no false closure
entry_rule: Descriptive entry signal only if a history condition has CNN excess AE AND SE versus BOTH last-observed and history-mean in Train AND Validation, all3seeds, both rowweighted and common-entity-equalweighted. Each metric/baseline sign and weaker consistency also reported. No p-value or causal assertion. Even a passing signal requires architecture review against prior Adaptive/MultiLag/LevelHistory before any new model.
limitations: Candidate individual prediction rows unavailable: no candidate-minus-CNN history decomposition
Train and Validation distributions/history support differ; common-entity weighting does not remove target quantity/history confounding
same target used across seeds; no tripling sample size
naive arithmetic references are descriptive, not new learned baselines
criteria not optimized on observed results
